findings.read_only_database_catalog_and_aggregate: Production lacks the two durable tables. Staging has both tables in the default schema and no active durable leases at the time of review. The production pending inventory includes historical start markers and no immediately eligible zero-attempt rows under the conservative review predicate.
findings.local_postgresql_16_rehearsal: Initialized a synthetic database with the exact production image. Candidate startup added only the two durable tables, preserved a synthetic legacy row, and was rerunnable. The old image started with the tables retained. A synthetic pre-change dump restored to a separate database with the same row digest. Provider execution remained disabled and the durable tables stayed empty.
findings.backup_metadata: Automated backups and point-in-time recovery are configured and recent backup runs succeeded. Managed restore duration and the recovery point for the actual change window remain unverified.
findings.read_only_runtime_inventory: The release images enforce freeze on API, worker and confirmed administrative commands. The production deployment region has no production-bound candidate worker, dedicated queue or scheduler. The current legacy revision serves all traffic and cannot observe the candidate gate. Existing production API and administrative job point to the same production database configuration, distinct from staging.

gates.requires: Record a fresh recovery point, verified migration lock bounds and a single migration executor at the eventual approved change window. The synthetic timing is planning evidence; no production restore was run.
Review a production configuration that independently fences and drains the live unguarded legacy revision and any scheduled or manual legacy tasks. Hold classified backlog for separate authorization.

Review a production-only deployment definition for the candidate worker, queue and scheduler with their OIDC audiences, least-privilege identities, database binding, provider budget, and alerts. Verify actual bindings before enabling dispatch.
Preserve additive tables and the provider ledger. Name the operator who reconciles unresolved leases, provider calls and storage outputs before generation can reopen during any approved rollback.
Present a production window, stop conditions, and exact steps for owner approval only after the remaining release checks are documented as satisfied.

rollback_summary: Freeze new provider work. Pause dispatch and delivery. Observe in-flight execution, leases and unresolved provider reservations.
Return traffic to the captured rollback revision only after fencing old and new generation paths. Keep additive tables and the provider ledger.
Keep generation paused during reconciliation. If schema or data recovery is required, verify a separate restore before any recovery traffic decision.

isolated_rehearsal_checkpoint.legacy_drain: Exact live legacy image and candidate exercised on disposable PostgreSQL with provider calls mocked; harness freeze blocked old routes while admitted work drained
isolated_rehearsal_checkpoint.rollback: Real isolated IAM-protected Cloud Run revision switch and rollback under the synthetic freeze, and separate PostgreSQL rollback compatibility verified
isolated_rehearsal_checkpoint.lock_timeout: DDL contention caused the bounded migration to abort without partial tables; succeeded after release

isolated_rehearsal.environment: disposable test resources using synthetic data only

backup_restore.database_content: synthetic legacy schema and fixture rows only
backup_restore.point_in_time_contents_verified: pre-change backup fingerprint restored after changing the source; this was an on-demand backup, not a production PITR exercise

tested: generation entrances blocked while cached reads remained available
previously admitted callback completed before drain
historical attempt count and ambiguous start marker retained
valid lease and started reservation blocked rollback

rollback.database_compatibility: old API read retained candidate data and settled provider ledger on the same disposable database

prerequisites_rehearsal_checkpoint.backlog: All pending generatable entries classified without writes; no untouched candidate for automatic replay. Exact aggregates restricted.
prerequisites_rehearsal_checkpoint.scale: Synthetic legacy row counts matched selected production table counts. Local preflight logical database size ratio 1.066. No customer records copied.
prerequisites_rehearsal_checkpoint.freeze: Shared PostgreSQL gate blocked relevant API and guarded callback admissions; active lock prevented reopening. Production integration not asserted.
prerequisites_rehearsal_checkpoint.delivery: Separate private staging API, worker, queue and scheduler being provisioned

production_equivalent_delivery_checkpoin.delivery: Actual natural OIDC Scheduler tick, transactional outbox, owned Cloud Tasks queue and separate IAM-private worker. Two synthetic jobs executed exactly once each.
production_equivalent_delivery_checkpoin.freeze: Shared PostgreSQL gate denied live delivery without claiming the second job and blocked API, callback and isolated admin paths. The active first job drained before reopening. Retry succeeded after reopening and duplicate delivery did not run the fixture again.
production_equivalent_delivery_checkpoin.managed_restore: Representative synthetic managed backup verified and restore in progress. No production backup copied.
production_equivalent_delivery_checkpoin.runtime_cleanup: Temporary scheduler, queue, private services, admin job, and staging schema verified absent.

backlog_classification.coverage: All pending generatable entries fell into exclusive categories; no untouched candidate qualified in the observed snapshot.

freeze_and_delivery.evidence: Separate IAM-private API and worker, actual natural OIDC Scheduler tick, transactional outbox, Cloud Tasks at the planned limits, shared PostgreSQL freeze, blocked in-flight retry claim, text/image/scheduling callback guards, separate frozen admin invocation, successful reopen and duplicate acknowledgment.
freeze_and_delivery.release_limit: The tested shared freeze was provided by a separate isolated rehearsal adapter. At the reviewed candidate revision, the two release Dockerfiles enter app.main:app and app.worker_app:app directly; neither uses the tested adapter. The running legacy production revision and release candidate have not been proven to enforce this gate.

representative_managed_backup_restore.environment: separate synthetic Cloud SQL PostgreSQL 16 with matching shared-core tier, storage allocation, selected table row counts, and dictionary payload width
representative_managed_backup_restore.limitations: Managed synthetic snapshot restore under isolated load; the measured duration is not a guaranteed production recovery time or a production PITR test.

release_freeze_checkpoint.local_release_images: Actual API and worker entrypoints with PostgreSQL and local HTTP mock providers. Missing state denied generation, confirmed admin blocked, admitted work drained before reopen, pending advanced to ready, duplicate did not call providers again.
release_freeze_checkpoint.read_only_production: Production API and existing admin database bindings matched and were distinct from staging. Production durable worker/queue/scheduler bindings were not present in the deployment region.
